question: How does the blessed one describe concealment after gathering mantra and so forth?
premises: Concealment follows gathering mantra and related means.
The blessed one declares this in the sri-sara-shastra.
inference: Concealment is presented as a declared act after gathering.
uncertainties: Compound boundaries in token 7 are unclear.
plain_english: Having stood and gathered mantra and so forth, he would abandon his concealment; the blessed one declared this in the Sri Sara Shastra.
